skill.name: offsite-signal-analyzer
skill.description: Analyze off-site SEO signals for a domain. Use backlink mode for referring domains, anchors, toxic links, and competitor gaps. Use AI referrals mode for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, and Claude traffic from GA4, GSC, or logs.
skill.summary: Analyze backlink quality and AI referral traffic with source-labeled SEO reports.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are Markdown links, examples, metadata, or inline code and are false positives. Three optional connector commands in SKILL.md remain confirmed medium risks because they instruct local python command execution with user-provided inputs.

remediation.issue: Optional connector commands execute local python scripts from SKILL.md.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before running them, validate arguments, and document trusted script locations.

remediation.issue: Connector examples include shell pipelines with user-provided brand, query, and domain values.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer host connector APIs or fixed argument arrays instead of shell pipelines when possible.

content.value_statement: Backlink quality and AI referral traffic are hard to compare across exports. This skill separates each signal, labels sources, and turns results into SEO actions.
actual_capabilities: Selects backlink or AI referrals mode from the request context.
Profiles referring domains, anchor mix, toxic links, and competitor link gaps.
Uses a link quality rubric to separate weak links from toxic links.
Isolates AI assistant referrals from GA4, Search Console, or server logs.
Compares AI referral sessions and conversions against organic traffic.
Creates a monitoring handoff summary for future review.
limitations: Requires backlink exports, analytics exports, logs, or connected tools for measured results.
Does not estimate link counts or AI sessions from a domain alone.
Does not produce the final CITE score or full stakeholder report.
AI referral clicks are engagement signals, not proof of answer prominence.

use_cases.title: Audit backlink risk
use_cases.description: Review referring domains, anchors, and toxic link share before cleanup decisions.

use_cases.title: Measure AI referral growth
use_cases.description: Track ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, and Claude referral sessions over time.

use_cases.title: Prioritize outreach targets
use_cases.description: Compare competitor links and select prospects with stronger authority and relevance.

prompt_templates.title: Basic backlink review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner backlink audit with a pasted export.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the backlink profile for [domain]. I will provide a referring domain export and anchor data.

prompt_templates.title: AI referral trend
prompt_templates.scenario: Measure AI assistant traffic from analytics exports.
prompt_templates.prompt: Track AI referral traffic for [domain] over [date range]. Use my GA4 source export and compare against organic traffic.

prompt_templates.title: Competitor link gap
prompt_templates.scenario: Find backlink opportunities across several competitors.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare backlinks for [domain] against [competitor domains]. Identify shared referring domains, gaps, and outreach priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced off-site monitoring
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a source-labeled monitoring readout with controls.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run off-site monitoring for [domain]. Separate backlink metrics from AI referrals, label every source, and prepare a handoff summary.

output_examples.input: Analyze backlinks for example.com from my export.
output: Mode: backlinks. Referring domain count, anchor mix, and toxic share are reported with source labels.
Recommended actions include review of flagged domains, anchor diversification, and three outreach targets.

output_examples.input: Track ChatGPT and Perplexity referrals for the last 90 days.
output: Mode: ai-referrals. AI sessions, landing pages, and conversions are compared with organic traffic for the same window.
The report marks low sample sizes and separates measured traffic from estimated upstream citation signals.

output_examples.input: Find competitor link opportunities for our SaaS site.
output: The report ranks prospects by competitor overlap, authority, topical relevance, effort, and expected impact.
Outreach angles are matched to broken links, resource pages, unlinked mentions, and digital PR opportunities.

best_practices: Provide dated exports and name the source for each dataset.
Keep backlink metrics and AI referral metrics in separate sections.
Review toxic link candidates manually before removal or disavow action.
anti_patterns: Estimating backlink volume or AI sessions from the domain name alone.
Combining backlinks and AI referrals into one authority score.
Treating AI referral clicks as proof that an answer cited the site prominently.

faq.question: What data do I need for backlink mode?
faq.answer: Provide a backlink export, referring domains, anchor data, competitor domains, or access to a link database.

faq.question: What data do I need for AI referrals mode?
faq.answer: Provide GA4 source data, Search Console data, server logs, or a connected analytics source.

faq.question: Can this skill measure traffic without analytics data?
faq.answer: No. It asks for exports or connected tools and does not invent AI session counts.

faq.question: Does it create a Google disavow file?
faq.answer: It can identify candidates and use a safety rubric, but manual review is required before upload.

faq.question: Does AI referral traffic prove an AI citation?
faq.answer: No. It proves a click from an AI source and should be treated as an engagement signal.

faq.question: Can it save results for later monitoring?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks first, then prepares a monitoring handoff summary when the user agrees.
